brief:
Settlers maintained a blockade of three houses in the Ras al-Ain area of Qasra, south of Nablus, on Tuesday, continuing their siege for a tenth consecutive day under protection from Israeli occupation forces, according to Shehab Wire. The action marks an escalation in settler pressure on Palestinian property in the region.

The blockade represents an attempt to impose a new reality on the ground and seize control of the homes. Residents have faced restricted access and movement as the siege persists, with Israeli forces facilitating the settlers' presence throughout the operation.
